name: TypeWorkshop
title: Type Workshop
about: Structs, classes, enums, protocols, generics, error handling, concurrency and programming paradigms, each made visible: copy a struct and share a class side by side, push onto a generic stack, watch async let finish early, and see an actor land on exactly 1,000.
notes: This app also has UI tests, so Command-U takes a few minutes longer.
The Blocking mode in lesson 3.7 freezes the app for about four seconds on purpose, so you can see taps pile up.
